left knee comes up the wall

takes.performance_note: Single reviewer (the coding agent), from a contact sheet; not a panel review. Walk-up, crouch, jump, catch and hang read. The pull and the hips-back knee mantle read as a climb from the sheet. Still fails: the near thigh rests across the ledge corner (counted as penetration, not contact), the hands miss their marks while walking forward on the top, the far-knee phase swings the hip forward and back, and two feet touch the ledge on the step-up. Same weak point as the Crash Lab take (the mantle), with fewer and smaller faults.
